brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: 3 full/half bases (0,-1,0 full; 0,0,0 half-n; 0,1,0 full; -1,0,0 full) plus 1,0,0 half-w provides compact 4-cell footprint

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet

requirements.evidence: Current spike is solid type; platform requires mount variant. Configurator returned TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED with steps to replace spike with mount variant then add platform-sm, but out of turns before apply could be executed.

finish.summary: Build has drawer and correctly placed corner spike but platform not attached due to spike type mismatch and no turns remaining.
